Semiring hypotheses, coefficient actions, factor order, the finite-projective retraction proof and independent universes are retained; the present revision makes no proof-body change in this owner.

Preserve the scalar towers, contraction map and independent ring/carrier universes; no local-ring, graded-projection or Morita result is claimed.
